title: Matchmaking
text: “Well then, let’s head to the baths!”

It seems the people of Siltvelt have prepared a bathhouse, so I’ve decided to take a dip. Once again, I’ll be watching Yuki-chan and the others grow from the shadows. Not much time has passed, so there might not be much of a difference, but to be honest, this Motoyasu can track Filolial-sama’s growth down to the millimeter.

For example, ever since Filo-tan started living in the village, she’s been helping the slaves under Father’s command level up. Since she’s been fighting more often, the muscles needed for combat have grown slightly more defined. This shows just how important repetitive practice is; through daily training, Filo-tan—who was already strong and beautiful—has become even stronger. Perhaps as a result of this lifestyle, the sheen of her feathers was magnificent, and she was in excellent health.
That’s my Father for you! He’s truly a Filolial Master!

That’s why the Filolials are making dizzying progress day by day. That’s why I pop in almost every day whenever I get the chance. As I was walking through the castle, lost in these thoughts, my Father—accompanied by Sakura-chan—came running toward me, half-naked.
“Ah, Motoyasu-kun!”
“What’s the matter?”
“I was told the bath was ready, so I went to check it out—but when I got to this luxurious bath I was shown to, there were tons of women gathered there, and they swarmed all over me!”
Speaking in a breathless rush, my Father circled around behind me while keeping a wary eye on his surroundings.
“Thanks, Sakura-chan.”
“You’re welcome~”

Just then, a massive herd of pigs came charging toward us from ahead. The stench was so overwhelming it made my nose curl. What’s more, it was an extremely foul odor—even among pigs, this one had a rotten stench mixed in. Just a moment ago, I’d been lecturing my Father on the importance of purity. I, Motoyasu, will drive all these pigs out!
“Oink!”
“Oink-oink!”
As I was thinking this, the pigs came crowding up to me in a friendly manner, but I couldn’t understand a word they were saying.
“Sorry, but I don’t have time to think about that right now! I have to fight for the sake of the world!”

My father kept refusing, while the pigs kept oinking and making a racket. Ugh… the stench of pigs is making me feel sick. There’s even a puppy mixed in among them. Other creatures besides pigs are talking, too.
“Even so, God of the Shield… we want to nurture love with you.”
“That’s exactly it… You guys don’t know anything about me, do you? Suddenly suggesting a mixed-gender bath like this puts me on the spot!”
There was a loud *thud*. Then, there stood Éclair, frowning.
“Princess of Siltvelt and noble young ladies. I’m sorry, Lord Iwatani… but the Shield Hero is tired. I’d appreciate it if you could show a little more courtesy.”
Éclair declared in a threatening tone, her hand clenched on the hilt of her sword. Then the pigs started making a racket.
“Shall I silence them? They’re starting to stink like pigs, aren’t they?”
“Huh!? Motoyasu-kun, you don’t have to do anything, okay? If you go on a rampage here, you’ll just end up running away aimlessly again.”
“Mr. Kitamura, I’ll quiet them down right away, so please calm down.”
Just as Éclair said that to me—or was it almost at the same time?—a member of the Shusaku race, who serves as the representative of Siltvelt, arrived.
“What’s all this commotion about?”
“These women were lying in wait for me in the bath and cornered me.”
“I’m truly sorry to hear that. We dispatched beautiful women from various races in an effort to provide the best possible service, but it seems none of them met the Shield Hero’s high standards.”
“No… that’s not what I meant…”

I thought to myself, “So this guy’s the mastermind behind it all.” To assign pigs—or beasts just as lowly—to my Father is utterly ridiculous! I’ll make a bloodbath out of him. You’d better be prepared. For the sake of my Father’s mercy, I’ll spare him and just beat him half to death. Just as I reached for my spear, my Father, looking flustered, said to me:
“Motoyasu, calm down!”
“I’m calm!”

The Father’s orders are absolute, but I’ll grant him a little leeway. When I turned my gaze toward Éclair, she shook her head. It seems she isn’t the one. Then… I heard a sound like a cane tapping gently on the ground. When I turned around, a middle-aged man was walking slowly toward me, resting his hand on his cane.
“My, my, Shield Hero, you’ve come all the way from distant Melromarc. It is the utmost honor to meet you.”
“Hmm…”
“So, what exactly caused this commotion?”
“Yes. It seems a crowd of people rushed in, all wanting to share the same bath as Lord Iwatani—the Shield Hero—in hopes of meeting his approval…”
Éclair explained the situation while bowing deeply.
“Hmm, hmm. It seems the Shield Hero is in a bit of a bind. Allowing them any closer… I believe that would go against the tenets of our nation. What do you think, Chief of the Shusaku?”
“Grr…”
A member of the Shusaku race groaned in frustration.
“Now, now, young maidens. If you do not conduct yourselves with propriety toward the Shield Hero—and avoid making such a spectacle of yourselves—you will be punished.”
That must have been the decisive word. The swine slowly walked away.
“Then, please make yourselves at home in our castle…”
The Shusaku also took his leave.
“Thank you.”
Father thanked the elderly man of the Genmu race. The old man then waved his hand, as if to say it was no big deal.
“I merely offered some obvious advice to those who lacked decorum in their dealings with the Shield Hero.”
“Thank you, Ms. Eclair, as well.”
“Don’t worry about it. At the end of the day, I hold no real power in this country. That’s why I contacted someone I could rely on as quickly as possible.”
“Someone you can rely on?”
“I no longer possess the kind of power that would make me someone others could rely on, though…”
“What are you saying? Didn’t this whole incident happen precisely because of your words?”
“Hmm…”
The elderly Gemu slowly stroked his chin.
“What does the Shield Hero intend to accomplish in this country?”
“Me? Well, technically, it’s to fight the Waves—that’s why I was summoned—but… is there anything else?”
“I think you already know the reason…”

It seems my Father has figured something out? I wonder what it is? I, Motoyasu, don’t quite get it yet. Yuki-chan seems to have figured it out, but Kou and Sakura-chan are tilting their heads in confusion.
“I can imagine a few possibilities. I’ll be as careful as possible with my words.”
“I see. It seems this Shield Hero is quick to understand. I’d be grateful if the Spear Hero traveling with you would also be careful.”
“What are you talking about?”

“It might involve complicated international issues, so you need to be careful with what you say… For example, you can’t go around saying things like ‘attack another country,’ and he’s nodding to warn you about that.”
“I see. Got it.”
“Well, in this country, the Spear Hero doesn’t carry as much weight as the Shield Hero, but I’d still appreciate it if you’d be careful.”
It’s all a bit of a hassle, isn’t it? I wonder if my future Father has navigated issues like this before? I’m not really sure.
“It seems they’re treating me well here, but I can already feel my shoulders getting stiff… Maybe I should set out on an adventure soon to get stronger.”
“That would be a good idea. If you’d like, you could even take my granddaughter along as a companion.”
“Father…”
“I understand. This is just a hypothetical… My granddaughter would never make a mistake. She’s rather shy, after all.”
“Lord Iwatani, I’m going to ask the Old Master for his cooperation and make contact with the Queen of Melromarc. I want to help put a stop to Melromarc’s rampage myself.”
“Got it. Thanks for everything so far, Ms. Eclair.”
“Don’t worry about it. Once everything is settled… and my sins are forgiven, I’ll do my best to assist you, Mr. Iwatani and Mr. Kitamura.”
“Yeah, I’ll be waiting for that day.”
“By the way, Mr. Iwatani… I think it’s about time you got back in the bath.”
“Huh? Oh!”
My father, looking embarrassed, placed his hand over his waist—which was hidden by a towel—and headed back to the bath with Sakura-chan.

“Well, I’ll be staying in this country for a while, but Mr. Kitamura, please be careful as well. After all, the Three Heroes Church is an extremist group, and Siltvelt is an extreme country in its own right.”
“Understood.”

Yuki-chan and Kou saluted in unison as I saluted. Even after the bath, when it was time to eat, a crowd of pigs had gathered around my Father. As expected, my Father looked troubled as he refused them, and there was a scene where the pigs cried and clung to him… but it’s best not to let that bother you.

My Father ate his meal with a gloomy expression, his face turning pale. The cuisine in this country is quite wild. A whole, pig-shaped monster was brought out, roasted to perfection. Since it’s slightly different from a regular pig, it’s possible to tell them apart.
Oh, they also served raw meat, but both Father and I turned it down. Even I wouldn’t want to eat raw meat. However, Yuki-chan and the others loved it! They were eating it with great relish.
Seeing their faces like that, a smile naturally spread across my face.
